opportunities.title: Patched This Morning, Pwned by Lunch: Inside the Plex2Shell Exploit Chain
opportunities.why_now: Attackers weaponized the Plex2Shell flaws into working crypto-miner and backdoor payloads within hours of public disclosure, the exact patch-cadence failure this channel tracks.
opportunities.angle: Timeline breakdown: disclosure clock vs. exploit clock, with a checklist for self-hosted Plex admins on emergency mitigation.

opportunities.title: ConnectWise Just Killed Cloud Backups Mid-Breach — What Every MSP Client Needs to Know
opportunities.why_now: ConnectWise suspended cloud services and disabled backups amid an active cyberattack, directly threatening the downstream MSPs and small businesses that rely on it.
opportunities.angle: Explainer on single-point-of-failure risk in MSP tooling, with a 'what to do right now if you're a downstream client' action list.

opportunities.title: Nikkei Just Got Breached for the Third Time This Month — That's Not Bad Luck, That's a Pattern
opportunities.why_now: A major news organization disclosing its third breach in a single month (1.8M records) is a rare, quotable data point for the 'inevitable breach' thesis.
opportunities.angle: Short investigative timeline piece connecting the three Nikkei incidents to ask whether repeated breaches signal systemic security debt rather than isolated incidents.

opportunities.title: Drupal's 'Patch Now or Else' Warning: Critical Core RCE Flaw Has a Fast-Exploitation Clock Ticking
opportunities.why_now: Drupal itself is warning of imminent mass exploitation for a critical core RCE, giving this channel a hard patch-cadence deadline to publicize before attackers move.
opportunities.angle: Urgent patch-now advisory format with CVE details, affected versions, and a 'why Drupal sites get hit fast' explainer on exposure surface.

opportunities.title: ClickFix Is Eating the Internet: Siemens, ROMULUS, and the Fake-CAPTCHA Malware Epidemic
opportunities.why_now: Multiple outlets this week independently reported new ClickFix campaigns (Siemens Software Center flaw, new ROMULUS platform), showing this social-engineering technique has gone mainstream across threat actors.
opportunities.angle: Trend roundup connecting the dots across the Siemens, ROMULUS, and prior ClickFix stories to explain why 'fix your browser' prompts are now a top malware delivery vector.
